newsitem.title: BRAZIL: No national strike planned-Brazil dockworker union.
newsitem.headline: No national strike planned-Brazil dockworker union.

text.p: A strike by dockworkers in Brazil's key grains port of Paranagua will not spread to other ports throughout the country, said a director of the National Dockworkers Union in Brasilia.
"There will be no national strike," the director said.
Dockworkers in Paranagua stopped work at 1200 local/1500 GMT today over demands for a 21 percent pay increase which they say they are owed as of last year.

Although negotiations at Paranagua are continuing to end the stoppage, it could continue until Saturday. Earlier this week, there had been talk that other ports would hold sympathy strikes on March 6 and 7.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
